finding: Unbounded chart and XLSX export loading can exhaust server resources
implemented_controls: Project chart estimate option reads use a 100 item sentinel limit.
Project chart row fact reads use a 5000 row sentinel limit.
Project chart node, category, and supplier reads use query-level sentinel limits.
Large chart projects load selected estimate IDs only, falling back to the newest default pair instead of loading every estimate.
The XLSX route passes export-only tree loader limits of 1200 nodes and 3000 row items.
The XLSX route returns HTTP 413 before building the proposal model or allocating an ExcelJS workbook when the tree loader reports sentinel overflow.
The shared estimate-tree loader defaults remain unchanged for editing, reorder, delete, and template flows unless a caller passes explicit limits.
